NP Presspad 1.2.7 — Empty custom fields, and settings in the right place

Two fixes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

## Sync

- Posts with an empty dropdown or number custom field could not be pushed — the sync failed with a 400 naming the field, even on posts where you had never set that field in the first place. WordPress's custom fields accept neither of the values a client can send for "this field is empty", so an untouched field was enough to block the whole post. Empty values are now sent in a form it accepts.
- This is the same underlying problem as the repeater fix in 1.2.4. That one hid this one: the earlier failure stopped the request before it reached these fields.

## Settings

- Your preferences were being saved outside the app's data folder, which meant "Reset app" left them behind and backups of your data missed them. They now live alongside everything else, and your existing settings move across automatically the first time you open this version — nothing to redo.
